use: report only: model paybill and employees are divided by these anchors in the receipt; never a target, never a guard
concept_notes: D.11 is whole-economy wages and salaries (public and private, including wages in kind) on a national accounts basis, calendar 2024.
PAYE RTI aggregate pay covers payrolled employees' pay (pensions excluded) for tax year 2024-25; the employee count is the mean of monthly payrolled employees.
The binding paybill guard stays ASHE annual jobs x mean pay (0.85-1.25).
